name: Piedimonte Matese (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Piedimonte Matese (three cypresses on white) within branches, with the inscription CITTÀ DI PIEDIMONTE MATESE in yellow arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Piedimonte Matese, a comune in Campania; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms were recognised by decree of the Head of Government on 17 July 1929.

features.role: Piedimonte Matese arms — three cypresses on white, crowned, within branches
inscription CITTÀ DI PIEDIMONTE MATESE arched above the arms
